نتخضخض (form IIq)
# نَتَخَضْخَضُ (nataḵaḍḵaḍu) /na.ta.xadˤ.xa.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَخَضْخَضَ (taḵaḍḵaḍa)
# نَتَخَضْخَضَ (nataḵaḍḵaḍa) /na.ta.xadˤ.xa.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَخَضْخَضَ (taḵaḍḵaḍa)
# نَتَخَضْخَضْ (nataḵaḍḵaḍ) /na.ta.xadˤ.xadˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَخَضْخَضَ (taḵaḍḵaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
